stats.notes: IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2023 first-time students): 4,945 applicants, 4,043 admitted, 1,889 enrolled. College Navigator fall 2024: 5,855 applicants, 78% admitted. IPEDS reports no nonresident-alien applicant counts for UCO, so no international admit figures are shown; nonresidents are about 3% of undergraduates (fall 2024, rounded). UCO reports ACT only (no SAT percentiles). Undergraduate enrollment 10,777 and the 18:1 ratio are fall 2024. No readable Common Data Set was found for this college, so these are figures from IPEDS; GPA, residency and class-rank details are not included.

cost.notes: College Navigator 2024-25: tuition and fees in-state $8,818, out-of-state $19,704; on-campus food and housing $9,700, other $8,400; the total cost of attendance is the out-of-state on-campus total
